insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to orders modified through the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware that tax recalculations will occur when updating the shipping address. This may impact custom tax calculation logic or integrations with external tax services. Review your app's tax handling to ensure compatibility with this change. Specifically, verify that your app correctly handles tax updates when modifying orders via the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and reducing potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to comply with tax laws and avoid potential penalties. This update ensures that Shopify's tax calculations remain reliable and up-to-date.
